quests.title: Tea Party Re-Invitation: Arlecchino

dialogue.t: A pleasant time indeed. Thank you for your hospitality, Sandrone.

dialogue.sit: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)
I think it's time I started clearing up.

quests.description: Go to the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Arlecchino…
